replacements.name: named-seconds-assigned-hour-independent-parts
replacements.text:
int session_seconds = (int)game_sequence_id / 1000;
    int session_hours;
    grim_interface_ptr->grim_draw_text_small_fmt(
        xy.x - 38.0f,
        xy.y + 230.0f,
        "played for %d hours %d minutes",
        session_hours = session_seconds / 60 / 60,
        session_seconds / 60 - session_seconds / 60 / 60 * 60,
        session_seconds
            - (session_seconds / 60
               - session_seconds / 60 / 60 * 60) * 60);
